title: PaymentCaptureRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for capturing a payment intent. V1 records the capture as an evy.transactions row with type "capture"; a real Stripe PaymentIntent capture will be called later. Server-side constants: full-amount capture (no amount_to_capture), payment_provider="stripe", fees 0, signature="signed".

payment_intent_id.description: The payment_provider_transaction_id from the intent row.
